reason: Both are engineered-product manufacturers selling through distributors and contractors into commercial construction. Carlisle sells building envelope products: roofing, insulation and waterproofing. SPX sells HVAC equipment (cooling towers, boilers, electric heat, air handling) plus detection and measurement systems. The HVAC product link is thin: Carlisle has only a small HVAC brands line. The detection and measurement half of SPX has no overlap with Carlisle. Customers overlap partly, through contractors and commercial building owners. SPX also sells to utilities and transit agencies, which Carlisle does not. So there is partial overlap in customers and a different core product, which makes this adjacent rather than direct.
